registration.note: the draft is not registered; this plan may not be executed before an explicit registration act, and after it is written no threshold, weight or window may change

question_zh: 在冻结的 MLPLOB v3 CSZ 主干与 441 日训练窗上，把单一 30 分钟标签换成 5/15/30/60 四个前向 VWAP 收益标签、一个主干四个输出头、推理时固定等权混合，在同一个 1.32 有效 epoch 预算点上，十窗样本外 RankIC 的配对差是否为正。
hypothesis: short and long forward-VWAP labels share most of their cross-sectional signal but not all of it; averaging four heads trained on the same trunk reduces label-specific noise, so the blended score should beat the single 30-minute head at matched budget if horizon diversity carries real signal. A pooled paired difference at or below the pre-declared floor falsifies the arm.

definition.label_k: close(t + k) / vwap((t, t + k]) - 1, the official forward-VWAP form
definition.primary_column: the 30-minute column is the official vwap_return target verbatim
definition.rebuild: 5/15/60 are rebuilt in one bounded pass over the 1-minute bars with the same form
definition.masks: per-horizon NaN masks; the training row set stays the 30-minute selection
definition.clock: trading clock skips the lunch break (11:30 + 30m = 13:30); a horizon without enough session left is NaN
definition.targets: per-horizon timestamp z-score then train-set RMS-matched scaling, fitted on the training split only
definition.heads: one trunk, four Linear(80, 1) heads; loss = equal average of per-horizon masked MSE
definition.score: fixed equal average of the head outputs in each head's optimization units

default_path_unchanged.claim: with data.label_horizons absent or [30] the labels, windows, loss and state are bit-identical to the registered path

factor.note: the only changed recipe key; the training window, validation split, evaluation split, seed, model dimensions and optimizer are the control's

environment_only_changes.note: path-only changes required by the training host: data and cache live on the container-local disk, run artifacts under /mnt/work (network disk that survives a container restart)

budget_only_overrides.model.max_steps: cleared; the registered trajectory steps govern the budget
budget_only_overrides.model.epochs: kept as the upper bound (must exceed the last budget point)
budget_only_overrides.data.splits.train.start: moved earlier to 2023-04-14; the single changed factor
budget_only_overrides.note: any other deviation from the frozen recipe must fail the run guard
budget_only_overrides.data.label_horizons: the single changed factor; not a budget knob. The recipe keeps the control's experiment_id and output_root, so the runner allocates a unique timestamped run directory per arm (nothing is overwritten); prefer an explicit per-arm output_root at launch.

budget_points.name: mh-1.32
budget_points.role: scored point: the 441-day rung anchor (145269 steps at batch 32 on hz-t3, 145290 on hz-4, derived at run start)

budget_points.name: mh-stepup-1.33
budget_points.role: throw-away step-up point (~+1100 optimizer steps): exists only because validate_budget_points demands two strictly increasing points; never scored, never exported

exposure.reconcile: samples_seen == steps * batch_size; unique/usable coverage >= min_coverage; realised effective epochs within atol of the declared point

resume.fail_closed: pool, recipe, fitted transforms and sampler batch order must reproduce the checkpoint exactly
resume.note: the two budget points are checkpoints of one uninterrupted trajectory, not two runs

derived_reference.calibration: level-1 measured 1054256 usable samples over 132 trading days, scaled linearly by trading days; the driver re-derives both from the pool actually built

deviation_tolerance.rule: a realised value beyond +/-5% stops the run and reports; the estimate is not edited afterwards

concurrency.sharing: packed by the memory pre-flight, not by a fixed map

evaluation_scope.cloud: validation split 2023-11-01..2023-11-15 = 10 trading days, process diagnostic only
evaluation_scope.formal: the five declared research windows produced locally by replaying exported per-budget-point weights; a cloud validation score is never the delivery evidence

candidate_score.definition: fixed equal average of the K head outputs, each in its own optimization units
candidate_score.note_zh: 头权重写死为 1/K，训练后不改，也不用开发窗分数再调

non_scored_point_exclusion.rule: the 1.33 point may never enter any comparison, blend, checkpoint selection or reported metric

checkpoint_naming.rule: scripts/run_training_trajectory.py names each point weights after the budget-point name

scoredfirst_conversion_note: converted from a one-point plan because the trajectory driver refuses fewer than two budget points; the 1.33 point is a throw-away step-up, not a budget rung

seed47.why: the generated recipe still carried the registered 441-day ladder identity (scaling-441d-seedN) and its output_root; both were rewritten so this arm cannot be mistaken for, or write into, the registered rung
